integrity: An analytic pointwise shell eigen-equation and positive ground-state remainder establish all-function sharpness. The finite checker is supplemental. Publication priority and independent correctness audit remain open.
scientific_limitations: Quadratic Vladimirov--Taibleson Hardy form, finite consecutive full p-adic valuation shells, and 0<alpha<n. Nonconsecutive masks, nonlinear energies and general ultrametric spaces are not claimed.
title: Exact nonradial finite-annulus Hardy gap on \(\mathbb Q_p^n\)
